newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close down, off day's high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close down, off day's high.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down on profit-taking before the Friday-Saturday weekend after gaining in early trade, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange's 100-share index closed 7.10 points, or 0.51 percent, down at 1,378.45 after rising to 1,390.61 in early trade. Losers led gainers 141 to 90.
Profit-taking brought down the index, dealer Rony Byramjee said. The market was likely to remain bearish owing to "election fever" before national elections on February 3, he said.
PSO fell 12 rupees to 266 and ICI 0.40 to 17.75. PTCL closed unchanged at 27.10. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
